before.descent: Standard peak descent: one 30 m rappel from a slung horn on the south/southwest side of the summit, then sandy scree and snow clockwise around the peak back to the base, about 50 minutes.
before.rappels: Descent is over the top by the standard walk-off: a single 30 m rappel from a slung horn on the south/southwest side of the summit, then scree scrambling clockwise around the peak. No rappel route is published for the line itself; retreat means building anchors.

Descent is over the top: a single 30 m rappel from the slung horn on the south/southwest side of the summit, then a scree walk-off. The finish is described as simulclimbing blocky ground leftward to the summit rather than rappelling the route.
